subject: Maintaining pilot access while invoice processes — short runway request
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@elarahealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@elarahealth.com
Date: 2026-10-25 09:12 PDT
Subject: Quick ask — keep pilot running while invoice clears

Hi Sergio,

We're almost across the finish line with procurement but finance is still routing the PO internally — the vendor onboarding team says the PO will hit their queue later this week. In the meantime our engineering team is demoing Redwood in two customer calls next week and we'd lose momentum if the sandbox is throttled.

Can Redwood temporarily keep our pilot environment live for 72 hours (or provide a small promo credit) while procurement finalizes the PO? I attached the draft PO and a short usage summary so you can see this is low risk.

We really appreciate the flexibility — happy to provide the PO number as soon as it's generated.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Integrations | Elara Health

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO.

We can do a short runway to avoid interruptions. Proposed approach:
- Provide a 72-hour pilot credit to keep your sandbox unthrottled while the PO routes.
- Require the PO number or signed Doc within 5 business days to avoid further extension.

Camila / Ben — do we have precedent here to approve a 72-hr top-up for deals at this stage? Laura, tagging you for a quick finance sanity check on risk and to confirm we can issue the credit before a PO is in the system.

Maya — if that works, we'll provision the credit today. Can you reply with the expected PO date / approver name so we can link the grant to the deal?

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
